labels.notes: Enhanced Chinese physics lab report. Data table with Time/Period/Frequency measurements. Analysis section about water column experiments, measurement accuracy. Clean typed text, well-structured.

Enhanced screen capture of handwritten Chinese physics notes about force decomposition. Similar to train_res_01647 but more faded/washed out. Toolbar visible. Bottom examples less clear. Enhancement only partially successful.
Enhanced handwritten Chinese convex analysis notes. Set operations, convex set proofs with lambda/matrix notation. Black ink on white, clear handwriting. Good enhancement quality.
Enhanced screen capture of handwritten Chinese chemistry notes. Chemical equations (CaO reactions), solution concepts. Blue ink on lined paper. Toolbar visible. Clean enhancement, good readability.
